haikus.haiku:
Soft fur hugs my hand
Snowflakes kiss the blanket bright
Warm smiles share soft joy
Happy #NationalTeddyBearDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Crispy breaded treat
Golden fried goodness sizzles
Tasty, tender joy
Happy #NationalWienerSchnitzelDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Golden light ascends
Wax melts slow on Tolstoy's cake
Winter's joy abides
#HappyBirthdayLeoTolstoy from @ClamBakeSanta
